page: Amazon Web Services r8id.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled as a 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance across multiple domains. The processor achieves a Passmark CPU score of 51,704.46 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,990.0, both placing in the top 25%. Text processing performance is particularly notable, ranking in the top 10% with a Geekbench score of 2,914.0. For memory-bound tasks, the uncached read-only large block bandwidth reaches 175.17 GB/sec. In language model workloads, the instance demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds of 388.5 tokens/sec for small 135M models, though performance drops to a weaker 2.78 tokens/sec for large 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r8id.8xlarge offers a dense allocation of DDR5 memory and high-speed local NVMe storage relative to its 32 vCPUs, reducing the need for external storage attachments. This resource profile is optimized for memory-intensive and storage-dependent workloads. Appropriate applications include database operations, Redis deployments, web serving, and moderate-scale language model inference.
